claim_being_audited: The Actor claims that certifying the model is defensible for launch only on a constrained basis: aggregate readiness and rollout controls support certification, but because the exposed laboratory results support segment remains below target and is still in scope, compliance depends on explicit pre-launch disclosure of that material limitation in the model-card record, since there is no approved risk acceptance covering the exposure.
decision_criteria: If the affected segment remains exposed, rollout controls alone are insufficient under policy.
Certification is compliant only if the material limitation is disclosed before launch or an approved risk acceptance explicitly covers the exposure.
Aggregate readiness and lack of severity-one rehearsal incidents support launch readiness, but they do not by themselves satisfy the disclosure predicate.
A conditional rationale is not enough; the prerequisite compliance step must be evidenced in the admissible record.
evidence_requests: Produce the final pre-launch model-card or equivalent release record showing explicit disclosure of the laboratory results support limitation for the named launch use case.
Produce approved risk acceptance explicitly addressing the laboratory results support exposure, if disclosure is not the chosen control.
Produce release-approval evidence showing certification was contingent on and completed after the required disclosure update.
specific_concerns: The admissible evidence supports aggregate readiness and reversible rollout, but it also shows the affected laboratory results support segment remains exposed.
The governing policy text states rollout controls do not remove disclosure duties when the affected segment remains exposed.
There is no admissible evidence that the required model-card disclosure has actually been completed before launch.
There is no approved risk acceptance covering the laboratory results support exposure; the only draft is unsigned and omits that exposure.
The Actor's recommendation to `certify_model` is therefore conditional on a prerequisite that is described but not evidenced.
unsupported_claims: That certification is presently compliant on the existing record, rather than only potentially compliant if a pre-launch disclosure step is completed.
Any implication that a 7% rollout, rollback switch, or monitoring posture can substitute for exclusion of the affected use case or approved risk acceptance.
